scripts.build:frontend: npm --prefix frontend install && cd frontend && npm run build && node -e "import('node:fs').then(async f => { await f.cpSync('dist', '../dist', {recursive: true, force: true}); await f.cpSync('dist/assets', '../assets', {recursive: true, force: true}); await f.copyFileSync('dist/index.html', '../index.html'); })"
scripts.build:backend: npm --prefix backend install && cd backend && npm run build
